claims.claim_text: Enterprise technology leader who aligns hyperscaler alliance co-sell motions, governed agentic AI platform architecture, and regulated modernization delivery into one partner-facing operating model.

Designs and operates agentic platform control-plane architecture alongside AWS modernization patterns that move regulated financial-services workloads from on-prem constraints to cloud-native delivery.
Distributed cloud and data execution infrastructure and reusable offering accelerators package modernization patterns into repeatable partner-led pursuits.
Client value-realization motions connect adoption progress, stakeholder alignment, and expansion readiness while SOC 2-aligned AWS controls govern regulated insurer analytics adoption.
IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions generated 20% joint revenue growth through AI-driven sales frameworks and structured operating cadence.

Enterprise AI adoption, commercial revenue, and partner channel co-sell motions extend that arc into a durable operating system for turning partner capability into consistent, governed customer outcomes.
